profile.headline: Software Developer at JPMorgan Chase & Co.
profile.summary:
Customer-focused and detail-oriented Software Developer with 7+ year previous experience in retail management;
completed college courses in Business Management and Computer Science. Highly organized and KPI-driven. Major
experience lies in delivering high-quality service within high pressure environments while maintaining a positive work
environment. Seeks to transfer strong interpersonal, business management, and technology skills of Java, Javascript, SQL, Spring Boot, React.js, Unit Testing, Kanban, Agile, UML, and Github to a software
development role.

positions.title: Software Developer in Training
positions.description:
-Admitted in Zip Code Wilmington’s highly competitive software development program which accepts around 13% of applicants.
-Gained experience in full-stack development with a focus on Java, test-driven development, object-oriented programming, and Spring Boot.
positions.insights: Skills: Problem Solving · Java · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Git · Teamwork

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description:
Processed merchandise returns and exchanges and resolved all customer complaints; responded to customer
needs, providing product information and aisle locations; trained 2 new shift managers.

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
-Manage inventory.
-Oversee store execution of sales and promotions.
-Provide in person training and development for baristas.
-Responsible for cashier balancing.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description:
-Ensured quality drinks and customer service.
-Trained new hires.
-Responsible for cleaning and closing store.

positions.title: Ice Cream Associate
positions.description:
-Provided quality customer service.
-Processed customer transactions and menu orders.
-Prepared water ice and catered to local events.
